read.title: Minutes from Our Weekly Sales Meeting
read.text:
Hi team,

Thank you for joining yesterday's weekly sales meeting. Please find attached the full minutes. Here is a short summary.

First, the attendees reviewed last month's results. Online sales grew by 12 percent, but store sales were slightly below target. Second, we discussed the holiday campaign and decided to start it one week earlier than planned.

There are three action items. Sarah will prepare a new price list by Tuesday. Kevin will check stock levels with the warehouse. I will follow up with the agency on the campaign schedule.

The next meeting will be held on Thursday at 10 a.m. in Room 3. Please review the minutes and let me know if I missed anything by the end of the day.

Best regards,
Minsu

write.en: Email the attendees the minutes of today's new product meeting, summarizing one decision and two action items, and ask them to tell you if anything is missing.
hints: Let me know if I missed anything
write.model:
Hi all,

Thank you for attending today's new product meeting. Please find attached the minutes. To recap, we decided to launch the new serum in April. There are two action items: Jisoo will finalize the package design by next Friday, and I will follow up with the factory on the production schedule. Let me know if I missed anything.

Best regards,
Minsu
